neighbours.label: the noun ' name' (or 'Name', 'ID') as the identifier of something, typically before ' of'
fire: The river gave its name to the small county around it.
It turned out that Brant was the name of a very old rocket.
Please write down the name of your dentist on the form.

account : str
    The name of the wallet that receives the funds.
Few of the guests could recall the names of the two authors.
By 1450 the word was the name of a kind of sweet bread.
user_id: the ID of the customer to fetch orders for
Only half of the patients could report the name of their pill.
quiet: The river gave its colour to the small lake around it.
It turned out that Brant was the maker of a very old rocket.
Please write down the time of your appointment on the form.

account : str
    The balance of the wallet that receives the funds.
Few of the guests could recall the ending of the two films.

user_age: the age of the customer to fetch orders for

notes: Card: ' name' x13, ' Name' x3, ' names' x2, 'ID' x2, ' index' x2, and promotes ' name' itself. Probe: 'the name of a town' 0.667; 'the name of a good counsellor' 0.677; 'The name of the account' 0.619; 'Name of the subject' 0.344; 'the capital of' 0.042; but 'the address of' 0.312, so other identifiers can fire.
